V10 provides the first executable local persistence/projection candidate, while the live-fusion replay must bind current work revision and promotion-grade observability before routing claims can advance.
clayresearch.next_experiment: Current-spec Hostinger OmniSource/source-reentry replay with real per-delta route and receiver/reentry receipts.

gwt.finding: V10 now has branch-receipt columns for delivered/reconstructed/plan_revalidated/used/local_effect, but the current V2 real-replay script does not execute that causal receiver chain. Promotion-grade GWT/reentry evidence therefore remains open.
gwt.next_experiment: Execute truthful/shuffled/broken-provenance receiver closure through OmniSource V10 and verify result re-entry.

frank.finding: No new Frank runtime evidence changes Frank architecture or authority. OmniSource/V10 belong to Clay research persistence/coordination; Frank remains separate and self-Harness authority remains proposal-only.
frank.next_experiment: No new Frank architecture experiment from this fusion.

emergenz.finding: V10 preserves open contradictions instead of hiding them, which is locally supported. Still test whether high-volume all-source intake creates overcoupling, false materiality or self-reinforcing evidence loops under real workloads.
emergenz.next_experiment: High-centrality contradictory burst with dependency/anti-entropy lesions and false-materiality/diversity metrics.

claycode.finding: Fusion still does not justify reopening BASE semantics. WP03 preservation remains distinct from WP04/WP05 legality/disposition/use; V10 SQL is persistence/runtime projection only and must not become a second semantic authority.
claycode.next_experiment: WP04/WP05 per-class disposition matrix, then compile equivalent OmniSource/reentry types through frozen Clay semantics when gate permits.

hyperposition.finding: Keep current promoted routing, V2 targeted/dense/digest alternatives and non-duplicate V3 fault mechanisms unresolved until matched current-spec evidence selects among them. Local V10 persistence does not collapse routing alternatives.
hyperposition.next_experiment: Matched sparse/local versus dense/global current-repo replays with route uncertainty preserved.

claygraph.finding: V10 adds dependency_projection_hash to branch/checkpoint receipts but does not itself prove the projection was the exact pre-route topology used by a policy. Current-spec replay must persist/reconstruct that state and inject missing/stale-edge faults against it.
claygraph.next_experiment: Pre-route projection hash/snapshot + per-delta RoutePlan replay with missing/stale-edge repair metrics.

unifieddb.finding: UnifiedDB V10 candidate locally passed 19/19 source-class schema coverage, stale-promotion rejection, distinct-provenance duplicate retention, contradiction preservation and specific reentry restart closure; 5000 observation+assessment pairs ran in 0.170692s. It remains CANDIDATE_TESTING because this was local sandbox evidence and two intentionally unclosed contradiction assessments correctly remained pending.
unifieddb.next_experiment: Authorized Hostinger/current-repo replay with real source/work events, crash/restart and receiver/reentry closure; compare V9/simple baselines and measure resources.

harness.finding: The first committed Hostinger replay workflow was stale-spec: it checked the 16:25 work revision and the script hard-coded spec_rev=2. It also used derived expected branches and did not execute the full receiver->research-reentry chain. A successful old run must be quarantined as stale diagnostic evidence. Workflow and work spec were repaired fail-closed for the 16:42 revision; no verified current-spec receipt was observed at cutoff.
harness.next_experiment: Run patched current-spec Hostinger workflow; adjudicate its receipt against pre-route/receiver/reentry/operational-fault requirements before any V2/V3 promotion.
